summary: Eton Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting a supply and distribution agreement for U.S. commercialization rights to IMPAVIDO (miltefosine) from a Knight Therapeutics affiliate. Terms include $4.25 million in fixed fees through 2032, up to $4 million in milestone payments tied to net sales, and ongoing royalties (55% up to $7M annual sales, 50% above). Eton handles sales/marketing; supplier covers product/regulatory costs. Exclusive rights begin Sept 26, 2026. This is a product licensing deal, not a full acquisition or divestiture. Categorized as 'Other' since it expands the rare disease portfolio but does not fit standard special-situation categories.
